decisions.reason: Eliminating or combining existing categories is owned by the question-set curation Requirement; the modernization actions for adding and rewording current content remain valid unchanged.
Permitting category elimination or combination does not change the required or conditional answer layers for questions that remain or are added.
The restructuring options apply to categories in the current edition and do not alter the separately required AI preparation chapter.
The option to restructure existing categories does not modify the planned candidate-questions chapter or its question-count policy.
The option to eliminate or combine existing categories does not modify the separately planned first-time-leader questions chapter.
Category restructuring may affect eventual allocation, but it does not change the 50,000-word limit or any current word-budget rule.
Existing-question category restructuring does not change the required leadership-focused, non-Q&A preparation chapter.
The restructuring options for current-edition categories do not alter the planned remote and hybrid leadership chapter.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing editorial review for proposed category, chapter, and question changes; no additional state update or removal is required.
The category-restructuring options do not change the Google Doc, suggesting-mode, or explanatory-comment requirements for tracked question deletions.
Restructuring manuscript question categories has no necessary effect on the companion-resource package.
The option to eliminate or combine categories does not change the book's target readers, principal markets, purpose, or quick-reference format.
